input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, never redrawn, never morphing, it only moves naturally with the fabric. The numbers '1966' and the word 'ISLAY' keep exactly the same upright shapes in every frame. A young Japanese woman at a warm whisky bar looks into the camera with a calm neutral face, then her eyes gradually soften and she breaks into a gentle, warm, genuine smile, tilting her head only very slightly, as if sharing a secret with a friend. Her shoulders and chest stay still. Natural subtle movement, same face and identity throughout, no exaggeration. Warm bokeh lights glimmer softly in the background. Avoid: zoom, zooming in, zooming out, camera push-in, dolly, pan, tilt, camera shake, garbled text, changing letters, misspelled words, nonsense text, extra text, new text, morphing print, print redrawing, warped logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, face morphing, identity change, different person, teeth distortion, flicker, watermark, captions, subtitles, laughing loudly, wide open mouth, exaggerated expression
